svg.text: J_MOTOR is inferred to face x- from its cable insertion center because no explicit footprint insertionDirection is defined, but should face x+ so the connector is accessible from the board edge. Set insertionDirection on the <footprint> to specify the actual direction in the footprint's unrotated orientation; for example, <footprint insertionDirection="from_above"> for a connector accessed from above the PCB (+Z).
Component J_PD extends outside board boundaries by 0.25mm. Try moving it 0.25mm down to fit within the board edge.
Component J_DATA extends outside board boundaries by 0.25mm. Try moving it 0.25mm up to fit within the board edge.
